name: linter
author: lumine-code
description: A unified linting package that combines linting infrastructure with an integrated UI

lintPreviewTabs.description: Lint tabs while they are still in preview status

lintOnOpen.title: Lint on Open
lintOnOpen.description: Lint files automatically when they are opened

lintOnChange.title: Lint on Change
lintOnChange.description: Lint files while typing, without the need to save (only for supported providers)

lintOnChangeInterval.title: Lint on Change Interval
lintOnChangeInterval.description: Interval at which linting is done as you type (in ms)

defaultSortMethod.title: Default Sort Method
defaultSortMethod.description: Choose the default sorting method for linter messages

enum.description: Sort by severity (error, warning, info) then line number

showHoverTooltip.title: Show Hover Tooltip
showHoverTooltip.description: Show linter messages when hovering over issues in the editor

largeFileLineCount.title: Large File Line Count
largeFileLineCount.description: Skip inline decorations for files with more lines than this (panel still works)

longLineLength.title: Long Line Length
longLineLength.description: Skip inline decorations if any line exceeds this length

statusMode.title: Status-bar item always visible
statusMode.description: When disabled, the status-bar item is hidden while there are no messages

editorScrollPosition.title: Editor scroll position
editorScrollPosition.description: Scroll zone as % of viewport height. Single value e.g. `0` is strict mode (always scroll cursor to that position). Two values e.g. `0-50` define a lazy zone (scroll only when cursor exits the zone). 0 = top margin, 100 = bottom margin.
